case.rationale: Exact initial duty with opposing vehicle within the intersection; record subject hold and later turn after opposing clearance.
unresolved_judgment_calls: Physical yield and signal sufficiency require local review.
No numerical immediate-hazard threshold is imposed because the selected opposite vehicle is within the intersection.
